description: Acquire and commit all real licensed assets with provenance, and prove each matches its storyboard beat. This produces: 15 Mixkit stock footage MP4s (+ reserves) in ad/public/footage/, 2 Mixkit music MP3s in ad/public/audio/music/, 16 edge-tts VO MP3s+VTTs in ad/public/audio/vo/, each dir with a SOURCES.md, plus the three fetch/generate scripts and ad/AUDIO.md. VO durations measured from the VTTs are recorded for later use by FEAT-003's narration config. This is the asset pipeline from CINEMATIC-FILM.md §6/§7/§8 and build order §14 steps 1-5. Network is OPEN_INTERNET. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: Create scripts/fetch-footage.sh (set -euo pipefail; curl -fL --retry 3): download each Mixkit footage id from https://assets.mixkit.co/videos/<id>/<id>-1080.mp4 into ad/public/footage/<local-name>.mp4 using the exact id->local-file->role mapping in CINEMATIC-FILM.md §8 table (8739 struggle-worried, 914 office-open, 221 office-glasses-reflection, 308 laptop-work, 918 office-busy, 4840 rooftop-sunset, 4809 meeting-collab, 30012 handshake, 29991 engineer-workshop, 1728 dev-code, 1735 dev-topview, 41642 multiscreen, 49878 city-aerial-night, 41637 ops-twoscreen, 4831 park-sunrise). Also download the reserves listed in §8 (1808, 41640, 41654, 1781, 242, 4915, 49845, 49846) so a swap needs no re-fetch. After each download assert the file is non-empty and MP4 (magic bytes / content-type), failing fast on a 0-byte or HTML response naming the id+URL.

In fetch-footage.sh, after each download probe the clip's real duration using @remotion/media-parser parseMedia (fallback: node_modules/@remotion/compositor-linux-x64-gnu/ffprobe) and emit each clip's durationInFrames @30fps so FEAT-003 can populate footage.ts. Write ad/public/footage/SOURCES.md recording per id: source URL, license URL https://mixkit.co/license/, 'Mixkit Free License — commercial use, no attribution', and the Mixkit title from §8.

CONTENT-VERIFY the clips: grab one still per downloaded clip into ad/public/footage/_contact/ (via a tiny OffthreadVideo single-frame `remotion still` probe, or ffprobe/ffmpeg-bundled frame extract via @remotion/renderer). Eyeball the stills. The four copy-bearing hero clips MUST be looked at explicitly: 8739 (worried owner), 914 (cold empty office before anyone arrives), 4840 (low-point silhouette), 4831 (warm resolution). On ANY mismatch with the storyboard role, swap in a reserve id, update SOURCES.md + the id->local mapping, and re-grab the still. Record in FEAT-002 findings which ids were kept vs swapped. Do NOT author scenes on a mismatched clip. NO AI-generated/synthetic footage — reject id 99786 and anything 'generic futuristic tech'.

Create scripts/fetch-music.sh (same curl discipline): download Track A id 18 -> ad/public/audio/music/track-a-tension.mp3 and Track B id 158 -> track-b-hope.mp3 from https://assets.mixkit.co/music/<id>/<id>.mp3. Confirm each is non-empty audio/mpeg. Write ad/public/audio/music/SOURCES.md with the scraped track title/page per id, license 'Mixkit Free Stock Music — no attribution'. Backups 168 (A) / 187 (B) noted but not required unless A/B are a poor fit by ear.

Create scripts/generate-vo.sh exactly per CINEMATIC-FILM.md §6: EDGE="${EDGE_TTS:-/root/.local/bin/edge-tts}" (never bare edge-tts); VOICE=en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural; hard-fail if the tool or voice is missing; for each VO line (ids+text from the narration config / an inline table matching §6) run edge-tts --voice $VOICE --rate=-8% --pitch=-2Hz --text <line> --write-media public/audio/vo/<id>.mp3 --write-subtitles public/audio/vo/<id>.vtt. The 16 lines (vo01..vo16) and their text are the §6 table; vo13='Built with intention.', vo15='Small enough to care.', vo16='Technical enough to build.' MUST be the verbatim copy.ts strings, and vo14='Your business has a vision. We build what brings it to life.' (the one new line).

Run generate-vo.sh to produce all 16 MP3s + VTTs in ad/public/audio/vo/. Parse each VTT's last-cue end time into durationInFrames @30fps and record the measured values (write them into a small JSON or directly into the findings) so FEAT-003 can set narration.ts durationInFrames to the MEASURED values (not estimates). Commit the MP3s and VTTs (render must not depend on network/pip).

Write ad/AUDIO.md documenting: the chosen voice + tuning (--rate=-8% --pitch=-2Hz), that edge-tts is at /root/.local/bin/edge-tts and NOT on bare PATH, how to regenerate VO (scripts/generate-vo.sh) and music/footage (the other two scripts), the committed-audio fallback, and the music track roles + ids.

Trim/select to only the clips actually used plus the realistic reserves; the design permits large real files but remove clearly-unused downloads before committing. Commit assets + scripts + SOURCES.md files + AUDIO.md on feat/cinematic-brand-film in a logical chunk (e.g. 'feat(ad): acquire licensed footage, music, and edge-tts VO for brand film'). Do NOT push.
acceptance_criteria: ad/public/footage/ contains the 15 named MP4s (post content-verify, with any swaps recorded) plus a SOURCES.md listing per-id URL + Mixkit Free License; each MP4 is a valid non-empty video file.
ad/public/audio/music/ contains track-a-tension.mp3 and track-b-hope.mp3 + SOURCES.md.
ad/public/audio/vo/ contains vo01..vo16 .mp3 and .vtt; vo13/vo14/vo15/vo16 texts match the required verbatim/new strings.
Measured durationInFrames for all 16 VO lines are recorded (from the VTT last-cue end times) for FEAT-003 to consume.
scripts/fetch-footage.sh, scripts/fetch-music.sh, scripts/generate-vo.sh, and ad/AUDIO.md exist; generate-vo.sh invokes edge-tts by absolute path and hard-fails if the tool/voice is missing.
The four hero clips (8739, 914, 4840, 4831) were explicitly eyeballed and confirmed (or swapped with the swap recorded in findings). No AI/synthetic footage used.
Assets + scripts + docs committed on feat/cinematic-brand-film.
verification: Confirm each VO .vtt has a last cue end time and the measured frame counts are recorded for FEAT-003

findings.commit: 9435065 feat(ad): acquire licensed footage, music, and edge-tts VO for brand film (on feat/cinematic-brand-film)

footage_kept_vs_swapped.all_four_hero_clips_eyeballed: 8739 struggle-worried (worried woman at dusk, hands to forehead) KEPT; 4840 rooftop-sunset (lone silhouette against orange sunset) KEPT; 4831 park-sunrise (warm golden-hour light through trees over a park/river) KEPT; 914 office-open SWAPPED.

swap.beat: film01 1.2 (HERO, cold/empty open office before anyone arrives)
swap.reason: 914 content is a BUSY, fully populated open-plan office across its entire runtime (eyeballed at t=0.2/5/10/18s) — the opposite of the storyboard's 'empty desks, cold light, realities waiting'. Would wrongly read as a thriving workplace in the Act-1 struggle.
swap.in: 1781 (quiet lone-desk laptop macro) -> renamed to quiet-desk-dawn.mp4; reads cold/isolated for the beat and does not duplicate the wider 308 'man working on his laptop' shot. 1781 remains available as a reserve copy too (reserve-1781-laptop-close.mp4).
swap.actions: removed 914 from the committed set (not a listed reserve); updated scripts/fetch-footage.sh CUT list + SOURCES.md swap note; re-grabbed the _contact still as quiet-desk-dawn.jpg.
swap.note_for_FEAT-003: footage.ts key 'office-open' should map to quiet-desk-dawn.mp4 (NOT office-open.mp4, which no longer exists). durationInFrames for this clip = 360.

footage_kept_vs_swapped.other_clips: All other 14 cut clips eyeballed via _contact/*.jpg and KEPT as-is (match their storyboard roles). No AI/synthetic footage used; id 99786 was never downloaded (rejected per design).
footage_kept_vs_swapped.candidates_tried_and_rejected_for_empty_: Blind Mixkit ids 4835 (woman on bench), 4836 (people+charts at desk), 1086 (ocean sunset), 2720/2721 (vertical Christmas trees) all fetched+eyeballed and rejected; none was an empty office. Chose the approved reserve 1781 rather than ship an off-spec/unverified clip.

clip_durationInFrames_at_30fps.comment: Probed at fetch time via @remotion/media-parser (fallback bundled ffprobe). FEAT-003's footage.ts consumes these. Reserves listed too for swap headroom.
clip_durationInFrames_at_30fps.window_le_clip_check: All §5 storyboard shot windows fit their clip durations with margin (tightest: 4831 window 156f <= 247f; 30012 window 150f <= 222f). The window<=clip invariant holds for every shot with the current mapping.

measured_vo_durationInFrames_at_30fps.comment: Measured from each VTT last-cue end time (Math.ceil(sec*30)). FEAT-003 MUST set narration.ts durationInFrames to THESE values. Also written to public/audio/vo/measured-durations.json.

findings.lockup_retime_flag_for_FEAT-003: The measured vo14 (120f, est was ~62f) and vo16 (61f, est was ~42f) are LONGER than the §6 estimates. With the §5 lockup starts as drafted, vo14 (start 2490) overruns beat-9.2 end (2568) by 42f and vo16 (start 2640) overruns the 2700 film end by 1f. This is the bounded, design-flagged re-time (§6 build-order dependency): FEAT-003 must start those lockup lines earlier within their beats and/or rebalance film09's sub-beats (keeping film09 total), gated by narration.test.ts's beatEnd-(voStart+voDuration)>=6 assertion. vo13 (53f) and vo15 (47f) fit their beats fine. Documented in ad/AUDIO.md.
findings.verbatim_vo_text_confirmed: vo13='Built with intention.' (==COPY.s06Tagline), vo15='Small enough to care.' (==COPY.s05a), vo16='Technical enough to build.' (==COPY.s05b), vo14='Your business has a vision. We build what brings it to life.' (the one new line). Confirmed against src/config/copy.ts lines 8/27/28/29 and the generated VTTs.
findings.music: Track A id 18 -> track-a-tension.mp3 (131.7s), Track B id 158 -> track-b-hope.mp3 (100.1s); both longer than the 90s film, probe as audio/mpeg. Primary A/B kept (not swapped to backups 168/187).
findings.verification: typecheck clean; existing vitest suite 16/16 green via `npm run test` (FEAT-001 config). ffprobe confirms struggle-worried.mp4 = video 1920x1080. All asset files are git-tracked (none gitignored).
findings.env_notes: edge-tts voice-check `--list-voices | grep -q` triggered a SIGPIPE/BrokenPipe under `set -o pipefail`; fixed generate-vo.sh to capture the voice list into a variable first before grepping. edge-tts invoked by absolute path /root/.local/bin/edge-tts. No system ffmpeg; used bundled @remotion/compositor-linux-x64-gnu/ffmpeg for still extraction.
